settings.verse: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord.

settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Set an atmosphere of worship. Place a small amount of oil on your fingertip and apply it to your forehead, hands, or the area you wish to anoint while speaking your prayer aloud or silently. Anoint yourself, pray over loved ones, or dedicate objects and spaces.

settings.heading: Ingredients & skin safety
settings.content: A base of premium olive oil with pure essential oils and natural fragrances. No artificial chemicals, synthetic fillers, or harsh additives. Patch-test on the inside of your wrist before first use if you have sensitive skin. Full ingredients are listed in the description above.

settings.heading: Shelf life & storage
settings.content: Keep in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and seal the cap after use. Our oils keep for approximately 12 to 18 months.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: See our shipping policy and refund policy for current timelines and terms.
